brand.prologue.styles:
<styles>
    <!-- Palette: ink, cream and signal orange come from the channel logo. -->
    <token name="pn-ink" value="#16181D"/>
    <token name="pn-ink-raised" value="#22252C"/>
    <token name="pn-cream" value="#F2EBDD"/>
    <token name="pn-cream-muted" value="#B8B1A4"/>
    <token name="pn-orange" value="#E8581C"/>
    <!-- Non-text only: grid lines, axes, dividers (contrast 1.66 on ink). -->
    <token name="pn-rule" value="#3A3E47"/>
    <!-- Data series, in this order: accent, neutral, cool. -->
    <token name="pn-data-1" value="var(--pn-orange)"/>
    <token name="pn-data-2" value="var(--pn-cream)"/>
    <token name="pn-data-3" value="#5FA8D3"/>

    <!-- Type: one variable family, Archivo (wght 100-900, wdth 62-125). -->
    <textStyle id="pn-base" fontAsset="pn-archivo" fallback="Archivo, Barlow Condensed, sans-serif"
               size="40" weight="400" variation="wght 400, wdth 100" color="var(--pn-cream)" lineHeight="1.3"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-display" basedOn="pn-base" size="120" weight="900" variation="wght 900, wdth 62"
               textTransform="uppercase" lineHeight="0.95" tracking="0"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-display-accent" basedOn="pn-display" color="var(--pn-orange)"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-heading" basedOn="pn-base" size="64" weight="800" variation="wght 800, wdth 75" lineHeight="1.05"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-body" basedOn="pn-base"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-label" basedOn="pn-base" size="28" weight="600" variation="wght 600, wdth 100"
               color="var(--pn-cream-muted)" textTransform="uppercase" tracking="80"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-number" basedOn="pn-display" size="160" color="var(--pn-orange)" features="tnum"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-cite" basedOn="pn-base" size="24" color="var(--pn-cream-muted)" lineHeight="1.25"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-data" basedOn="pn-base" size="28" weight="500" variation="wght 500, wdth 100"
               color="var(--pn-cream-muted)" features="tnum"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-caption" basedOn="pn-base" size="44" weight="700" variation="wght 700, wdth 90" lineHeight="1.2"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-caption-active" basedOn="pn-caption" color="var(--pn-orange)"/>
    <!-- Thumbnails and Shorts covers: cap height 137 px and 121 px from the 0.686 em cap ratio.
         The thumbnail may shrink a word that is wider than its column, but never below 197 px
         (cap 135 px here, 90 px on the 1280x720 upload); a word that still does not fit is replaced
         by a shorter one (EXOPLANETA? needs 182 px). -->
    <textStyle id="pn-thumb-headline" basedOn="pn-display" size="200" lineHeight="0.92"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-thumb-accent" basedOn="pn-thumb-headline" color="var(--pn-orange)"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-cover-headline" basedOn="pn-display" size="176" lineHeight="0.92"/>
    <textStyle id="pn-cover-accent" basedOn="pn-cover-headline" color="var(--pn-orange)"/>
  </styles>

<symbols>
    <!-- The brand mark: the orange right triangle of the logo, right angle at bottom-left.
         It sits flush on the frame's left edge by design, so it is forced outside the safe area (SA02). -->
    <symbol id="pn-notch" name="Notch" width="64" height="64" duration="1" safeAreaForce="true">
      <shape id="pn-notch-shape" shape="path" width="64" height="64" path="M0 0 L0 64 L64 64 Z"
             fill="var(--pn-orange)" tags="logo"/>
    </symbol>

    <!-- Opening title, 4 s: kicker, title, notch, on ink. -->
    <symbol id="pn-title-card" name="Title card" width="1920" height="1080" duration="4">
      <shape id="pn-tc-bg" shape="rect" width="1920" height="1080" fill="var(--pn-ink)"/>
      <layer id="pn-tc-kicker" asset="pn-t-kicker" x="192" y="300">
        <animate property="opacity" timeBase="local">
          <key time="0" value="0" interpolation="cubic-out"/><key time="0.4" value="1"/>
          <key time="3.7" value="1" interpolation="cubic-in"/><key time="4" value="0"/>
        </animate>
      </layer>
      <layer id="pn-tc-title" asset="pn-t-title" x="192" y="360">
        <animate property="opacity" timeBase="local">
          <key time="0.1" value="0" interpolation="cubic-out"/><key time="0.5" value="1"/>
          <key time="3.7" value="1" interpolation="cubic-in"/><key time="4" value="0"/>
        </animate>
        <animate property="y" timeBase="local">
          <key time="0.1" value="392" interpolation="cubic-out"/><key time="0.5" value="360"/>
        </animate>
      </layer>
      <instance id="pn-tc-notch" symbol="pn-notch" x="0" y="1016"/>
    </symbol>

    <!-- Chapter divider, 3 s: orange number, cream title. -->
    <symbol id="pn-chapter-card" name="Chapter card" width="1920" height="1080" duration="3">
      <shape id="pn-cc-bg" shape="rect" width="1920" height="1080" fill="var(--pn-ink)"/>
      <layer id="pn-cc-number" asset="pn-t-chapter-number" x="192" y="340">
        <animate property="opacity" timeBase="local">
          <key time="0" value="0" interpolation="cubic-out"/><key time="0.4" value="1"/>
          <key time="2.7" value="1" interpolation="cubic-in"/><key time="3" value="0"/>
        </animate>
      </layer>
      <layer id="pn-cc-title" asset="pn-t-chapter-title" x="192" y="540">
        <animate property="opacity" timeBase="local">
          <key time="0.15" value="0" interpolation="cubic-out"/><key time="0.55" value="1"/>
          <key time="2.7" value="1" interpolation="cubic-in"/><key time="3" value="0"/>
        </animate>
      </layer>
      <shape id="pn-cc-rule" shape="rect" width="1536" height="2" x="192" y="520" fill="var(--pn-rule)"/>
    </symbol>

    <!-- Lower third, 5 s, transparent: panel at y 680-832 leaves the caption band (centred at 85%) clear.
         Raised panel with an orange bar; orange is never type here. -->
    <symbol id="pn-lower-third" name="Lower third" width="1920" height="1080" duration="5">
      <group id="pn-lt" x="192" y="680" width="900" height="152">
        <animate property="opacity" timeBase="local">
          <key time="0" value="0" interpolation="cubic-out"/><key time="0.4" value="1"/>
          <key time="4.7" value="1" interpolation="cubic-in"/><key time="5" value="0"/>
        </animate>
        <animate property="x" timeBase="local">
          <key time="0" value="160" interpolation="cubic-out"/><key time="0.4" value="192"/>
        </animate>
        <shape id="pn-lt-panel" shape="rect" width="900" height="152" fill="var(--pn-ink-raised)"/>
        <shape id="pn-lt-bar" shape="rect" width="8" height="152" fill="var(--pn-orange)"/>
        <layer id="pn-lt-name" asset="pn-t-name" x="40" y="22"/>
        <layer id="pn-lt-role" asset="pn-t-role" x="40" y="98"/>
      </group>
